verdict.rationale: Rippling documents its own integrations that sync payroll with accounting systems (Xero, QuickBooks, NetSuite), which covers getting payroll entries into a ledger. It also advertises general platform APIs, developer docs, an llms.txt and a CLI that an agent could use. However, nothing shows a payroll journal API endpoint, a journal export, or an agent-driven reconciliation workflow. Missing for 10: documented payroll journal/GL API endpoints or export format, an evidenced agent-accessible path to pull payroll journal data, reconciliation capability, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
